newsitem.title: USA: Colorado cattle trade steady-off $1.00 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Colorado cattle trade steady-off $1.00 - USDA.

text.p: Trading of slaughter cattle moderate Tuesday.
Slaughter steers and heifers steady to 1.00 lower. Carcass basis sales steady.
Sales reported on 2,600 steers and 2,600 heifers.
Slaughter steers: Select and Choice 2-3 1175-1225 lbs 70.00-71.00. Carcass basis: Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1250 lbs 115.00.

Slaughter heifers: Select and Choice 2-3 1050 lbs 70.00. Carcass basis: Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1100 lbs 115.00. Confirmed Sales: 5,200 Last Week: 17,400 Last Year: 7,300 Week to Date : 8,100 Last Week: 17,400 Last year: 7,300
